text:
maria: Quick sync — aiming to finalize the enterprise one-pager (security + SLA + deploy modes) and the webinar outline. Target launch: Tue. Can folks review copy + routing rules? Draft link: https://redwood.internal/drive/onepgr-enterprise-draft :spiral_note_pad:

alex: skimmed it. overall good. one request: add a clear fallback matrix for Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private when capacity or compliance constraints hit. customers ask this a lot.

sam: I can own the benchmark narrative. plan: run p50/p95 latency, token cost/unit, and quality checks vs two open models. will include quantized vs FP16 comparison. need a test account (dedicated-staging) creds.

jen: for inbound routing, recommend simple HubSpot logic: if company_size > 500 AND needs_security = true -> route to Enterprise AE queue. otherwise score and route to SDR. I'll draft the exact steps.

kemal: webinar flow thoughts: 5m intro, 10m demo (deploy modes), 15m benchmark story + results, 15m ops/observability, 15m customer Q&A. keep demo short and scripted.

maria: +1 on flow. also want 1 slide that maps compliance needs to deployment option (Hosted, Dedicated, Private) with KMS/HSM and audit log bullet points.

alex: wording note from legal: avoid "on-prem" in external docs, use "private deployment (customer-managed)". also we should call out SLA tiers explicitly: Bronze (best effort), Silver (99.9% uptime), Gold (SLA + SRE support).

sam: benchmark details I'll capture in a slide and a short appendix one-pager. metrics to highlight: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, cost/token, fallback success rate, and model-quality delta (rouge/bleu-ish proxies).

jen: routing snippet (HubSpot) — paste into automation editor:
```
IF form_submitted = enterprise_eval AND company_size >= 500 THEN owner = Enterprise_AE
ELSEIF form_submitted = enterprise_eval AND security_checkbox = true THEN tag = "security_lead"; owner = Solutions_SE
ELSE score_by_activity -> SDR_pool
```
Include UTM for tracking: https://redwood.ai/demo?utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=one-pager&utm_campaign=enterprise_launch

alex: small ask on messaging: lead with predictable economics and SLOs, then security. engineers care about latency & cost first. sales want compliance up front. balance both.

maria: agree. i'll produce two headline variants (engineer-first, buyer-first) and we can A/B test in email/webinar registration.

launch-bot: Reminder: marketing assets due by EOD Friday for creative review. :bell:

kenmal: (typo) actually kemal :grimacing:

jen: i added a checklist in the draft: CTA (trial request), Routing tags, Webinar signup CTA, Benchmark appendix, Field playbook link.

maria: Thanks — actionable owners: sam (bench narrative + appendix), jen (routing + automation snippet), alex (legal wording + SLA table), kemal (webinar script), maria (copy variants + final one-pager). I'll merge and recirculate by EOD. :thumbsup:
